title: Trajectory Within the Head Envelope
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and $C$ a contract for $M$, with lower and upper head bounds for each work tape. For every parameter $i$ and starting configuration $d$ in the contract entry state and satisfying its precondition, at every time $u$ up to and including the prescribed running time, the vector of work-tape head positions lies in the box determined by those bounds; that is, each head position lies between its corresponding lower and upper bounds.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a parameter and $d$ is a starting configuration
$d$ is in the contract entry state
$u$ is at most the prescribed running time
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $C$ be a contract for $M$, with lower and
upper head bounds $\mathrm{lo}$ and $\mathrm{hi}$. For every parameter $i$ and
configuration $d$ starting in the contract entry state and satisfying its precondition,
at every time $u\le C.\mathrm{time}(i,d)$, each work-tape head position lies between its
corresponding lower and upper bounds.
